sql: SELECT "core_folder"."id", "core_folder"."name", "core_folder"."parent_id", "core_folder"."position", EXISTS(SELECT 1 AS "a" FROM "core_snapshot" "U0" WHERE ("U0"."folder_id" = ("core_folder"."id") AND "U0"."permissions" IN ('public')) LIMIT 1) AS "has_public_snapshots" FROM "core_folder" ORDER BY "core_folder"."position" ASC, "core_folder"."name" ASC, "core_folder"."id" ASC
query_plan: SEARCH U0 USING INDEX snapshot_folder_public_idx (folder_id=? AND permissions=?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
